sources.entry: Trae - AI-native IDE with Builder patterns. #free

summary.name: TRAE
summary.one_liner: TRAE is an AI-native coding environment (IDE) with multi-agent features, including a SOLO coding agent and a Builder mode for developing complete projects.
use_cases: Building a complete application from an idea with an AI agent
Delegating coding tasks to autonomous agents
Coordinating several AI agents on parallel development tasks
Writing and autocompleting code in an editor
Working through complex codebase changes with AI context
Learning a new programming language with AI help
summary.what_it_does: TRAE brings projects and tasks into one workspace where multiple agents run in parallel, with progress and status visible. Its SOLO coding agent takes a task from requirements through planning, implementation, database integration and deployment, according to the page's testimonials and description. Users can use built-in agents or customize their own, and agents can act as sub-agents for larger problems. The page says TRAE supports a community agent ecosystem for sharing and discovering agents. It also offers AI code generation, autocompletion and a Builder mode for complete projects.
notable: SOLO coding agent that plans, builds and deploys from a task description
Multiple agents run in parallel with customizable and sub-agent support
Local-first privacy approach: codebase files stored locally, Privacy Mode and ignore rules
Presented as a VS Code-style editor replacement
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Platform availability beyond the website is not specified on the page
Codebase files may be temporarily uploaded for embedding during indexing; user data is stored in the United States, Singapore and Malaysia
